# TextField

A single- or multi-line text input with a visible label, optional help text, an inline error tied to the input, an optional character count, and clear optional…

`SongNodes.TextField` · Inputs

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.TextField label="…" value="…" onChange={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.TextField" label="…" value="…" on-change="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (TextFieldProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` * | `string` | Visible label (noun, sentence case). |
| `value` * | `string` | Value. |
| `onChange` * | `(value: string) => void` | Change handler. |
| `help` | `ReactNode` | Help text with a real example. |
| `error` | `string` | Error message; sets aria-invalid and links it with aria-describedby. |
| `optional` | `boolean` | Marks the field "(optional)"; required is the default and not marked. |
| `maxLength` | `number` | Character limit shown as "18 / 40"; typing past it is allowed and shows an error. |
| `rows` | `number` | Multi-line textarea with this many rows. |
| `data` | `boolean` | Mono font for IDs and codes. |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | Read-only (dashed, focusable, copyable). |
| `disabledReason` | `string` | Disabled with the reason shown beside a lock icon. |
